text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're at summer camp, normally the<n>perfect time
to focus on training. But...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... So, howdja like Windy'srunning? All eyes on the beach are...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Biko's so fired up! Okay, I gotta kick<n>my butt into
high gear too!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this! I'm gonna be just like<n>those three.
No one is gonna beat me<n>on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Not on me! Guhhh... This leaves me<n>with no choice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Graahhh! Now I'm angry! Screw you,<n>summer
camp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lack of attention is tanking her<n>motivation and
focus. We're in for a<n>rough summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? The summer festival's<n>canceled?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Apparently it like clashed with<n>the festival in
the next town over or<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
They said if they're at the same time,<n>people will
just go to the other<n>festival, so they just won't do
it this<n>year.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: But we'd probably miss curfew if wetried heading out there... Sigh. Nosummer festival this year, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on taking Windy to the<n>festival as a
post-training treat, but oh<n>well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wait around until after sundown, but<n>Windy still
hasn't returned to the<n>dorms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to find her, I venture out<n>along the
narrow, unlit roads. But just<n>then...
AHHH!
choice_data_list: Was that a scream just now?!

text_block_list.text: GYAHH! P-please, have mercy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear scream after scream coming<n>from the woods.
What's going on?<n>What if something's happened
to<n>Windy?

text_block_list.name: Village Leader
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! Now that has a kick to it! I can<n>feel it tickling
my brain!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! Go on, go on—gimme<n>more! And let's
get some fun goin'<n>on over there too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the lively noises, I find a<n>clearing lined
with rows of lanterns<n>and handmade banners—a
small<n>festival.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, Trainer! So, whaddya think<n>of Windy's
festival? Looks like a<n>super fun time, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Some of the takoyaki are laced with<n>mustard! All
raffle draws are grand<n>prizes! And on stage, you
can try yer<n>hand at the mystery box challenge!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
With a dash of Windy mischief, we<n>can blow the
neighboring town's<n>festival out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text: GYAHHH! Aghh, I got one of the<n>mustard takoyaki.

text_block_list.name: Villager B
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! Wh-what the heck is in this<n>box?! It's all
slimy and cold!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon now, do your best and make<n>a guess. ♪ Ya
don't want to miss out<n>on Windy's special prank
goods!

text_block_list.name: Villager C
text_block_list.text:
I've never been to a festival like this!<n>There's so
much variety!

text_block_list.name: Villager D
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Hey, don't you agree<n>this wouldn't
overlap with the other<n>festival at all? It's nothing
like what<n>we had before!

text_block_list.name: Village Leader
text_block_list.text:
If it's a student of Tracen Academy<n>giving us all
these ideas, we've got<n>to put them into practice,
don't we,<n>folks?

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Woo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word of the event reaches camp in<n>no time, and
students start streaming<n>over.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Windy! This has been<n>nonstop excitement!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
So, the mustard takoyaki—was that<n>your idea?! It's
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
We never would've thought of<n>anything like this.
We'll use some of<n>these ideas next year too.
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Neeheehee. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew... Mission accomplished!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Cleanin' up was a pain, though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course they did! I'm a prankster<n>genius! Don't
you know?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Remember what you told me<n>before? That I'm
super-duper<n>creative?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's 'cause I'm a big bad.<n>Evil needs a
steady stream of ideas.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So, you know... I have all these ideas<n>at my
command...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And... well, the thing is... they're goin'<n>to waste!
I've got more ideas than I<n>can use!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So I got to thinkin', maybe it wouldn't<n>be a bad idea
to share some of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I could give pranks to<n>those in need!
I'll make everyone<n>dependent on me, and then
they'll all<n>be my lackeys!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll be in high demand.
I'm sure you'll be in high demand.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yep! Pretty soon everyone will want apiece of my pranks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And when that happens, I'll be too<n>busy to deal
with them all, so I'll<n>appoint you as my eternal
assistant!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And wouldn't ya like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the smug look on her face<n>brimming with
excitement, I don't<n>have to think twice before giving
a<n>hearty nod.
